title: Quick Peruvian Broccoli Relleno Causa
description: A quick and flavorful Peruvian dish featuring purple-sprouting broccoli, a sweet glaze, and crispy potatoes. This causa limena is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Caution glaze
ingredients.notes: equal parts honey and soy sauce

instructions: Pierce the potatoes with a fork and bake for 45 minutes, or until tender.
Meanwhile, cut the broccoli into florets and toss with olive oil, salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes on a baking sheet. Roast for 10-12 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelized.
In a small bowl, whisk together the caution glaze. Add the garlic and whisk until combined.
Once the potatoes are done, let them cool for a few minutes before slicing them into 1/8-inch thick rounds.

To assemble the causa limena, spread a layer of potato on the bottom of a serving dish, followed by a layer of broccoli, and then a layer of caution glaze. Repeat this process until all ingredients are used up, finishing with a layer of potato on top.
Bake the causa limena in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Garnish with chopped chives and serve hot.
